newsitem.title: UK: One Brent date kept, the other clocked - trade.
newsitem.headline: One Brent date kept, the other clocked - trade.

text.p: One Brent cargo nominated into the forward paper chains on Tuesday was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline while a second went unclaimed, traders said.
British Petroleum, which has kept most of the October programme released so far, kept one of the Oct 9-11 cargoes while Texaco was clocked with the other, they said.
An Oct 4-6 Brent traded at a firmer Nov Brent plus three cents on Tuesday.
